scope: Tier 4 Step 9 existing-data families. Ready means an existing shared question has both a reviewed chat adapter and deterministic SQL recipe; review rows name the serving contract still required.

capabilities.prerequisite: Publish a canonical tender_notice_lineage(tender_id) function with notice type, publication date, TED identifier, predecessor/successor links and official URL.
Expose a current-as-of-date CPRS registration lookup by canonical company EIK, including registration groups, validity period and unmatched status.

Contract stable expert and expertise-area identities with validity dates on each expert-area relationship, an explicit as-of rule, organization and source date, plus unresolved and ambiguous person states.
Define one comparable CPV, period and value-basis cohort and expose award criterion, bid count, concentration denominator and per-contract benchmark without treating contracted value as paid.
Promote only after one serving query returns crawl time, deadline, beneficiary eligibility, aid rate, grant range and official condition URL from the same current procedure version.
Expose a canonical procedure-fit result with eligible beneficiary type, geography, activity, amount bounds and quoted official evidence; absence of rejected applications forbids approval-rate claims.

Expose the aid or co-financing rate, eligible-cost denominator, applicable procedure version and effective date from quoted official conditions; do not infer applicant approval rates without rejected applications.
Contract project status, contracted amount and verified paid amount at one dated snapshot, keeping financial correction and completion status separate.

Publish programme title, countries, funding period and coverage beside stable programme, operation and partner identifiers, roles, amounts and source URLs; deduplicate Interreg rows already included in unified EU-funds totals.
Resolve one hospital identity and return comparable monthly or annual NZOK payments with coverage start/end, ownership and explicit missing months.
Join hospital financial statements and reported activity only on canonical hospital and compatible periods, exposing units and coverage rather than implying payments equal activity.
Expose one INN and pack identity with reimbursed units, paid amount, unit-price basis and quarter; compare only matching dosage, pack and period.
Publish the molecule-level comparison denominator, reference price, hospital price, quantity and caveats behind potential-savings estimates before dual-output promotion.
Expose stable municipality, meeting and resolution identifiers with decision text, date, official source URL and corpus coverage interval.
Resolve councillor identity by mandate and retain yes, no, abstain, absent and unpublished states for councils that publish named votes.
Join magistrate identity, court role and declaration filing by covered year, preserving relationship scope, filing type and unresolved names.
Contract one court identity and comparable year/case-type workload series with reporting coverage, disposition denominator and absent-year semantics.
Expose project-site geometry separately from beneficiary registered seat, with project identifier, observed period, funding programme and location confidence.
Publish stable facility identity, facility type, physical coordinates, operator and observed-validity period before map questions become ready.
Keep directorate service territory, headquarters point and incident geography as separate grains and publish the official coverage version.
Ingest geocoded dated crash records with severity and road segment; national fatalities cannot support a local hotspot claim.
Expose generation by technology with physical unit, observation interval, source publication date and missing intervals in one canonical SQL serving series.
Expose household and non-household price basis, consumption band, taxes, currency, observation period and source freshness without joining incompatible series.
Resolve each facility and technology with installed versus available capacity, physical location, validity date and source version before map or ranking promotion.
Resolve applicant identity and preserve requested, awarded and paid amount bases, programme, commission decision date and grant-corpus coverage.
Resolve film and producer identities with production year, subsidy programme, requested and awarded amounts, commission decision and NFC source version.
Expose benefit programme, recipient-count denominator, paid amount, period and geographic grain without merging distinct allowance schemes.
Compare the same product definition, package unit, store and observation date; retain missing observations and source collection time.
Expose indicator code, unit, price basis, national period and revision date; forbid comparisons between nominal, real and percentage measures without conversion.
Expose NUTS version, regional code, indicator unit, observation period and missing regions, and compare only the same geographic classification version.
Expose resident-population measure, Census 2021 reference date and settlement or municipality grain without presenting it as current registered population.
Expose permanent-address and current-address registered populations separately with quarterly observation date and stable settlement or municipality identity.
Expose poll fieldwork dates, sample, methodology, election target and source lock; compare agencies only within the same election and preserve undecided treatment.
